notes.text: Rasmus Sandin is on long-term injured reserve (knee surgery) and has missed the last 14 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Timothy Liljegren has taken his spot beside Martin Fehérváry. That pair has had 47% of the chances at 5-on-5 in 97:04 together.
Jakob Chychrun has started killing penalties: on the ice for 26% of the team’s shorthanded time in 18 games, up from 8% last season.

They dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen in 6 of their last 10 games, including the last one. Yanni Gourde takes shifts on two lines, L3 and L4. Emil Lilleberg is the seventh defenseman, rotating in mostly beside Moser and Crozier.
Anthony Cirelli is day to day (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. Nikita Kucherov has taken his spot beside Jake Guentzel and Brandon Hagel.
Erik Černák is day to day (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. Max Crozier has taken his spot beside Ryan McDonagh.
Sam O'Reilly was added to the roster on Nov 12 and has played beside Yanni Gourde and Jake Guentzel.
John Carlson is no longer killing penalties: 3% of the team’s shorthanded time in 20 games, down from 47% with his old team last season.

story.head: The Capitals give up shots, and the Lightning take them
paras: The Lightning won the teams’ first meeting this season, 3-1 in Tampa Bay on Oct 3. The Capitals (10-8-0) lost 7-4 to New Jersey on Saturday, and the Lightning (13-5-2) lost 2-0 to Detroit the same night. Going in, the Capitals are fifth in the Metropolitan (tied for 20th in the NHL) and the Bolts first in the Atlantic (tied for sixth).

The Capitals get the league’s best looks (1st), get their shots through to the net (2nd) and have had some of the best goaltending in the league (5th). The Lightning keep shots away better than almost anyone (3rd) and draw more penalties than they take (4th), but don’t block many shots (29th). The Lightning are likely to get plenty of pucks to the net against the Capitals. On top of that, the Lightning could find some good looks against the Capitals, who give up plenty of them.

Dylan Strome (3 G / 13 A / 16 P in 18 GP) leads the Capitals in scoring, and Alex Tuch (11 G / 2 A / 13 P in 18 GP) has a team-high eleven goals. Nikita Kucherov (8 G / 20 A / 28 P in 20 GP) leads the Lightning in scoring and is tied for tenth in the NHL, with eight points in his last five games. Brandon Hagel (13 G / 11 A / 24 P in 20 GP) has a team-high 13 goals, sixth in the NHL, with seven points in his last five games and six goals in ten games against Washington since 2023-24.
Logan Thompson (7-5-0 / .889 SV% in 13 GS) is expected to start for Washington, and Andrei Vasilevskiy (9-5-1 / .888 SV% in 15 GS) for Tampa Bay.
At home, Jon Cooper likes to send Viel, Gourde and Geekie out against opponents’ fourth lines, so watch for them against Ovechkin, Protas and Sourdif.
